info.title: GeoSphere Platform — Enterprise GIS & Telemetry REST API
info.description:
# GeoSphere Enterprise API Gateway

The **GeoSphere Platform** provides high-performance, enterprise-grade geospatial analysis, real-time telemetry processing, vehicle fleet management, multi-tier SaaS billing, and low-code Application Studio capabilities.

## Key Architectural Capabilities
- **Multi-Tenant Isolation**: Complete isolation across Organization, Workspace, and Role boundaries.
- **High-Throughput Telemetry**: Ingestion pipelines supporting JSON, GT06 GPS trackers, and MQTT bridges with automatic PostGIS indexing.
- **Server-Side Spatial GIS**: PostGIS and Turf.js spatial operations (area, buffer, centroid, bbox, distance, nearest, within, intersects).
- **Administrative Boundaries**: High-precision boundary search supporting Countries, States, Districts, and Tehsils with OpenStreetMap hybrid sync.
- **Application Studio**: No-code dynamic module composition and publication engine.
- **Immutable Audit Ledger**: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliant activity logging.

## Authentication & Authorization
- **Bearer JWT**: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` header obtained from `/api/v1/auth/login`.
- **API Key**: For backend microservices and IoT devices, provide `x-api-key` header.
- **Tenant Scope**: Specify `x-organization-id` and `x-workspace-id` headers to target specific organizational branches.

tags.name: System Health & Metrics
tags.description: Liveness probes, Prometheus metrics, and system diagnostic telemetry.

tags.name: Platform Administration
tags.description: Super-admin governance: enterprise licenses, cross-tenant overrides, SDK releases, and master subscription controls.

tags.name: Alerts & Incidents
tags.description: Security and telematics incident alerts (speed violations, geofence breaches, SOS, battery drops).

tags.name: Application Studio & Dynamic Modules
tags.description: No-code/low-code Application Studio, versioned business modules, JSON layout configuration, cloning, and publishing pipelines.

tags.name: Compliance & Audit Trail
tags.description: Immutable SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audit ledger tracking administrative, security, and GIS actions across the platform.

tags.name: Authentication & Identity
tags.description: JWT session lifecycle, credential verification, dual-token rotation, and self-service password recovery.

tags.name: Dashboard Metrics & Statistics
tags.description: Executive dashboards: vehicle status breakdown, active alerts, operational distance, and live fleet utilization.

tags.name: Developer Portal & SDK Management
tags.description: Developer API keys, SDK access catalogs, version registries, package credentials, and real-time usage metrics.

tags.name: Billing, Subscriptions & Entitlements
tags.description: Multi-tier SaaS billing plans, feature entitlements, tenant quotas, upgrade/downgrade lifecycles, and invoices.

tags.name: GIS Layers & Maps Configuration
tags.description: GIS map layer management, vector tile styling, basemap configuration, and map workspace presets.

tags.name: Multi-Tenant Organizations & Workspaces
tags.description: Enterprise multi-tenancy: organization profiles, team invitations, RBAC member management, and isolated branch workspaces.

tags.name: Mobile SDK & Offline Sync Engine
tags.description: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) mobile sync: device registration, offline data packs, delta sync, media uploads, and remote tasks.

tags.name: General
tags.description: Platform core utilities.

tags.name: Reports & Analytics Export
tags.description: Fleet performance reports, driver safety scorecards, fuel efficiency metrics, and CSV/PDF data exports.

tags.name: Automated Rules & Triggers
tags.description: Rule-based event triggers, conditional logic engines, automated email/webhook actions, and execution audit history.

tags.name: Spatial Analytics & Telemetry Aggregation
tags.description: Spatial analytics, trip track reconstruction, dwell time calculations, and geospatial time-series rollups.

tags.name: Administrative Boundaries (GIS)
tags.description: Precision administrative boundaries hierarchy (Countries, States, Districts, Tehsils) backed by OSM Nominatim & local datasets.

tags.name: Spatial Features & Data Management
tags.description: GeoJSON feature collections, spatial entity indexes, dynamic point clustering, GeoJSON/KML/CSV import/export pipelines.

tags.name: Geofencing & Spatial Boundaries
tags.description: Geofence lifecycle, circle/polygon boundaries, real-time spatial evaluation, and entry/exit transition triggers.

tags.name: Spatial Tracking & Locations
tags.description: Real-time location SSE streaming, current location snapshots, historical location trails, and batch location ingestion.

tags.name: Spatial Analysis & Geometry Operations
tags.description: Server-side PostGIS & Turf spatial math: area, perimeter, buffer, centroid, bbox, intersects, within, distance, and nearest.

tags.name: Spatial Search & Querying
tags.description: Geospatial queries: viewport bounding box, radius queries, nearest-neighbor, point-in-polygon containment, and intersection index.

tags.name: Background Tasks & Jobs
tags.description: Asynchronous task execution, batch job polling, geoprocessing jobs, and scheduled telemetry rollups.

tags.name: Telemetry & GPS Ingestion
tags.description: High-throughput GPS telemetry ingestion (JSON, GT06 hex, MQTT), time-series storage, and SSE dispatch.

tags.name: Map Tile Services
tags.description: Dynamic Vector (MVT) and Raster Map Tile server: /api/v1/tiles/{layer}/{z}/{x}/{y}.

tags.name: Tenant Usage & Quotas
tags.description: Metered API consumption, spatial storage tracking, device counts, and rate limit telemetry.

tags.name: Vehicles & Fleet Management
tags.description: Fleet asset CRUD, vehicle metadata, live GPS snapshots, and speed/heading telemetry.
